description: Serial port monitor for embedded development: HEX/text views, timestamps, CRC/Modbus checksums, periodic send, command presets and auto-reconnect. One panel per port, many ports at once.
config.portPollIntervalMs: How often to re-enumerate serial ports, in milliseconds. Desktop has no plug/unplug events, so the port list is refreshed by polling.
config.statusBar: When to show the serial item in the status bar. It is also the main entry point for creating a panel.
config.statusBar.always: Always visible, so a new panel is one click away
config.statusBar.whenActive: Only while at least one serial panel is open
config.statusBar.never: Hidden; use the command palette instead
view.empty:
No serial devices found.
[Refresh](command:serialTool.refreshPorts)
Plug in a USB-serial adapter, or open an empty panel:
[New Serial Panel](command:serialTool.newPanel)
lm.listPorts.userDescription: List serial ports and which ones are open in Serial Tool panels.
lm.readOutput.userDescription: Read recent data received from and sent to a serial port in a Serial Tool panel.
lm.send.userDescription: Send data to a serial port that is already open in a Serial Tool panel.
